s0.speaker: narrator
s0.text: The mirrors fell like rain. The Echo's light did not flee at once. It hesitated, as if looking back at you.

s2.speaker: monk_voice
s2.text: THREE. Come home, my son. Come HOME.

s3.speaker: narrator
s3.text: His trick stays with you - slipping through the gutters between panels.  (POWER: PANEL SKIP - longer, untouchable dash)
